name: Esto no es a lo que se refieren por comida flameada, maldita sea
source:
Dana Zane just wanted to have dinner, but her table suddenly caught fire. She is holding food in one hand, a drink in the other, and now her nose itches. 

You only have time for one action – what will she do?

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?t=25491]Lemmasoft forum[/url]]
translation:
达纳·赞恩 (Dana Zane) 刚想吃晚饭，但她的桌子突然着火了。她一手拿着食物，另一只手拿着饮料，现在她的鼻子发痒了。

你只有时间做一项事情——她会做什么？

[来自[url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?t=25491]Lemmasoft论坛[/url]]
